Method decision: any action by a government body or a person with official authority counts as a response (statements, warnings, advisories, investigations, orders, laws).

Version 0.2: added Thailand; 6 new cases (SG-I-05, TH-I-01 to TH-I-03, PH-I-03, PH-I-04), 8 new official responses and 9 new policies (6 Thailand, 1 Philippines, 2 ASEAN including DEFA, signed 14 Nov 2026). New Visitors tab with a live total, a region view, a country table, referring sites, tab use and downloads, shown only after 30 visits and with groups under 3 merged.
